scope: Independent NumPy F64 full-POS-logp metrics and raw-token reaggregation; own A residualization/bootstrap; component and actual-CP audits linked. No primary statistic imports, source edits or GPU reruns.

Dolma_held_positions.scope: Stored per-token metric reaggregation only, not regenerated full-vocabulary KL

POS_held_targets.scope: Full F32 POS logp independently exponentiated/summed F64, no renormalization

initialization.scope: Teacher gate rows supplied/frozen; initial experts and ordering unchanged; no teacher per-expert targets

limitations: Full-POS F64 reconstruction differs slightly from primary F32 accumulation; no predictor equivalence threshold used.
Component variance includes model-specific support, gate weight and expert content, not pure content.
Calibration maps held fixed; input cluster uncertainty, not seed treatment-effect CI.
Three shared seed pairs are dependent and both groups reuse an observed pilot.
A zero-on columns remain in registered row-centered statistic and may inherit mean effects.
Nonzero function/prediction variation and shared teacher bias preclude strict same-function decomposition-freedom claim.
